info.name: Wondercraft Public Account Convo Mode API
Generate AI-scripted podcast with 2 hosts using Convo Mode

items.docs: Generates a two-host conversational podcast from a natural-language prompt. Requires exactly two voice IDs and accepts optional delivery instructions and a background music spec. Returns a job_id to poll for status.

info.name: Generate podcast with 2 hosts using Convo Mode and a user-provided script

items.docs: Generates a two-host conversational podcast from a user-provided script of ordered segments. Accepts optional delivery instructions and a background music spec. Returns a job_id to poll for status.
